data.content: At how many sites has DDT been measured?

args.query: Count the number of unique sampling sites where the substance DDT has been measured (including both detected and non-detected) across all available years.

data.content:
The results comprise 1 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"n_unique_sites":{"0":140}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"n_unique_sites":{"count":1.0,"mean":140.0,"std":null,"min":140.0,"25%":140.0,"50%":140.0,"75%":140.0,"max":140.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (s:Substance)-[:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'DDT'
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS n_unique_sites

            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
DDT has been measured at 140 unique sampling sites (including both detected and non-detected), across all available years.

Cypher query used:
MATCH (s:Substance)-[:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'DDT'
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS n_unique_sites

Data source (Neo4j graph container):
https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
